verdict.rationale: Runloop's API/SDK and CLI let an agent programmatically create a Devbox (sandbox), execute commands with streamed/logged results (execute-commands, execution-logs, PTY, named shells, file access), and then shut it down or suspend/resume — all documented as callable via SDKs without human interaction, and reinforced by an 'Agents API' and GitHub Action for automated deployment. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on third-party confirmation of a fully autonomous end-to-end run (only first-party docs/tutorials), and no explicit example showing an agent autonomously deciding to tear down its own sandbox without a workflow script.
